title: AntBuddy Mobile — CRM Omni-channel App
summary: Production CRM mobile app (iOS + Android) for omni-channel customer support. Worked on call system, TikTok channel, push notification lifecycle, and Omni inbox.
content: Role: Frontend Developer at AntBuddy JSC (01/2026 – present).

Call system: integrated CRM call history with customer identity display, resolved call type handling and push notification token lifecycle issues to ensure correct behavior across login, logout, and account switching.
TikTok channel: added TikTok messaging support including conversation filtering and lead Q&A rendering within the message container.
Omni-channel inbox: extended action menu with channel-aware reply/forward logic and copy text support.
Push notifications: stabilized device token registration lifecycle on iOS and Android across all authentication states.
Tickets: implemented navigation to the Tickets screen with pre-applied assignment filter.
Cross-platform maintenance on both iOS and Android builds. Repository is private — production product at AntBuddy JSC.

title: AntBuddy Autotest — E2E Mobile Automation
summary: End-to-end automation test framework for AntBuddy's Zalo OA FlowBot. 83 UAT specs covering onboarding, bot flows, and CRM API verification on real iOS/Android devices.
content: Role: Frontend Developer at AntBuddy JSC — built and maintained the automation test framework.
Architecture: Playwright as test runner orchestrating Appium via WebDriverIO for real-device control on iOS and Android.
Covered UAT test specs across onboarding, FlowBot conversation flows, CTA interactions, and Zalo OA follow/unfollow.
Dual-layer verification: each test combines UI assertions with backend API validation to ensure full correctness.
OCR integration using Tesseract.js to extract text from device screenshots when standard selectors are not reliable.
Report pipeline: automated HTML, JSON, Excel, and dashboard reports generated from a single command.
Built modular utility layers for keyword normalization (Vietnamese diacritic-insensitive), Zalo interactions, API helpers, and platform-specific UI handling.
Repository is private — internal tooling at AntBuddy JSC.

title: Linora Social Network

content: Role: Frontend Developer Intern at Platinum Technology (06/2025 – 12/2025).

title: JinStore — Cross-platform Sales System
summary: Personal fullstack commerce system with web and mobile apps. Google login, OTP, VNPay payment, Cloudinary storage, and WebSocket realtime updates.
content: Personal project started 02/2025, ongoing.
Built web frontend (React JS + SCSS), mobile app (React Native), and REST API backend (Node.js + Express + MongoDB) from scratch.
Integrated Google OAuth login, OTP account verification, VNPay payment gateway, and Cloudinary for image storage.
State management: Redux Toolkit on mobile, Zustand on web. Realtime order updates via WebSocket.
